prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE transparent PNG game-art LAYER KIT for an actual character clock, with EXACTLY THREE well-separated artwork components across one horizontal row, no labels or text. Style reference is original cartoon Patrick Star from SpongeBob, clean simple 2D cel artwork, coral-pink skin, white sclera black pupils, green shorts purple flowers, friendly subtly amused expression, no realism. LEFT component (largest): a full front-facing seated Patrick central torso, head and two feet, WITHOUT the two side flippers: a clean game body layer designed for separate side-arm attachment; finish the round sides naturally, no sockets, gore or cut marks. Torso symmetrical, head upright, soles horizontal, no cushion or props. MIDDLE component: ONE isolated natural short Patrick starfish flipper, root on LEFT and rounded tapered tip pointing RIGHT, soft organic slightly curved plump silhouette, dark thin outline and same coral pink as body. RIGHT component: ONE slightly longer natural flipper, LEFT root and RIGHT rounded tip, same body color/line style; long is about1.3 times short length, same base width. Both arm roots thick rounded and unadorned, palms are not human hands; NO fingers, bones, cylinders, triangles, needles or mechanical pointers. Do NOT attach either arm to body in this source. All three separate opaque silhouettes have ample transparent space between them and minimum10% transparent margin from PNG edge. No shadows, halos, blue backgrounds, scenery, grid, captions, clock dial, watch, letters or arrows. Body and both flippers must be fully intact. Make this polished, simple linework close to the original animated series, not plush 3D. Keep outlines smooth with clear transparency. This kit will be placed and rotated as actual time hands at a shared pivot while digital time stays separate.
